## Model spend (metered, and its honest boundary)

From the proxy `events.wal` `measurement.cost.attributed` fold
(5,001 attributed calls of 5,140 requested; 139 request-failed/attempt
events not completed):

| Lane | Completed calls | Attributed µ$ |
|---|---|---|
| v5 | 1,446 | **1,740,548** |
| pi | 1,370 | **0** |
| claude-code | 2,184 | **0** |
| lane-probe | 1 | 8 |
| **Total** | **5,001** | **1,740,556** |

- **Pi/CC attributed 0 µ$ is a real, recorded limitation** — every
  pi/cc `model.call.completed` carried `usage.source: "absent"`,
  `tokens.input.total: 0`, `tokens.output.total: 0` (SSE responses
  upstream carried no usage object), so the proxy's table-priced
  attribution honestly folded 0. The calls are real: response frames,
  native logs, and CTRF verdicts exist per slot. **The provider-side
  `/api/usage` hourly buckets are the only bound on true pi/cc spend.**
- **Provider trailing-24h read (settled below):** the W4x window hours
  (2026-11-20T03:00Z..10:00Z) sum **$7.7627** across 8 nonzero
  glm-5.3-flash buckets (4,915 provider-counted requests) — i.e. true
  model spend ≈ **$7.76**, of which the harness metered $1.74; the
  ~$6.02 gap is window-internal unmetered pi/cc streaming usage.
- **Compute estimate: 3,173,300 µ$ ≈ $3.17** — `hh-compute-cost/1`
  `2026-11-20-fp-w4x-cost.json` (instance 2,400,448 + disk 368,074 +
  egress 360,000 + ipv4 44,778 µ$). Cloud Billing read pending.
- **Total ≈ $10.93 of the $100 ceiling** (~11%); under the $7.99
  declared spend-bound at provider level (7.76M < 7,988,890 µ$).

### Harvest remediation note (honest)

The first `gce-backend.sh harvest` invocation's IAP-tunneled
`compute scp` stalled at 49,873,920 B for ~25 min and was killed
(`Refused{harvest.failed}`). The pull was completed via chunked
`dd`-over-SSH (13 × 50 MiB sequential reads, ~5 MB/s) and verified
byte-exact: tar sha256
`c5afd9ce0f74b02ad8769cc0450d2210b96b0ad7b35c3674291525428b9596da`,
663,796,565 B — the remote sha256 matched and the subsequent
teardown-step-2 harvest re-verified the full 27,908-member manifest.
journald.log + serial.log + usage.txt captured; hh-secret-scan
leak-sweep PASS on all three text files.
